description: This Java class implements a PaymentModule specifically for PayPal Express Checkout, handling payment initialization, authorization, capture, refund, and transaction processing via PayPal API integration.

classes.name: PayPalExpressCheckoutPayment
classes.description: Implements payment processing methods for PayPal Express Checkout, including transaction initialization, authorization, capture, refund, and detailed PayPal API communication.

methods.name: validateModuleConfiguration
methods.description: Validates that required API credentials (api, username, signature) are configured for PayPal integration.

methods.name: initTransaction
methods.description: Method not implemented; intended to initialize a payment transaction.

methods.name: authorize
methods.description: Authorizes a payment transaction using PayPal, requiring a payment token.

methods.name: initPaypalTransaction
methods.description: Creates a new PayPal payment, sets up transaction details, and redirects user for approval via PayPal API, returning a Transaction object with token info.

methods.name: authorizeAndCapture
methods.description: Authorizes and captures a PayPal transaction in one step.

methods.name: refund
methods.description: Processes a refund through PayPal API, either partial or full, returning a new Transaction record.

methods.name: processTransaction
methods.description: Handles detailed steps to execute a PayPal checkout, including getting checkout details, creating payment, and executing payment via API.

methods.name: capture
methods.description: Completes a pre-authorized PayPal transaction (capture), recording the authorization ID and transaction details.
